question: In what form is the vital air present within all living beings?
premises: Air is described as filled with breath
This air is present in all beings
Its presence is established within them
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is unusual and may reflect transmitted text
plain_english: The breath-filled air is situated in all living beings.
